meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: Claude 能把你给的素材(文件夹、网址、笔记或对话)整理成技能文件 SKILL.md,含步骤与注意事项;也能用新内容更新已有技能。提炼只用自带的读写、搜索、抓取工具。
howto.when: 当你说 /learn、learn this、make a skill from <来源> 等指令,或要求把目录、网址、笔记等素材变成技能、更新已有技能时触发。

say.note: 把刚才一起完成的操作提炼成可复用技能。
将笔记结构化生成技能文件。
用新学到的东西更新这个已有技能。

howto.what_en: Claude can turn a folder, URL, pasted notes, or recent conversation into a reusable SKILL.md with steps and gotchas, or update an existing skill with new learnings. It uses only built-in file read/search/fetch/write tools.
howto.when_en: When the user says /learn, learn this, make a skill from <source>, etc., or asks to turn a folder, URL, or notes into a skill, or update an existing one.

say_en.note: Distill the recent conversation into a reusable skill.
Turn the pasted notes into a structured skill file.
Update the existing skill with new learnings.
